_comment: Tracker-only provenance accessions for the datasets integrated into HypoExplorer. Used by vite.config.js to detect a candidate that is the SAME raw data re-deposited under a different accession (e.g. a BioProject or a non-GEO mirror that the explorer's datasets.js does not record). This file does NOT affect the deployed explorer. Resolved via the dedup-verify workflow on 2026-06-19; extend it whenever a dataset is added to src/data/datasets.js.

macaque_snrna.note: Lei et al., Cell Metab 2024 (PMID 38325338). Raw data in CNGB/CNSA (China National GeneBank) under CNP0003785 — no GEO/SRA/GSA/OEP mirror. datasets.js records only the DOI.

mouse_hypo_hfd_gse220533.note: Parent BioProject of GSE220533 (Gpr101 loss, whole hypothalamus; Helmholtz Munich). 32 SRA experiments.

mouse_arc_hfd_gse225038.note: Parent BioProject of GSE225038 (Klf4 deletion in Agrp cells, arcuate; MCW/Grobe). PMID 38145289 — NOTE the same paper also deposited GSE224716 (GT1-7 cell line), a DIFFERENT dataset the explorer does not include; PMID-only matches are flagged as 'same paper', not 'integrated'.

mouse_hypo_maternal_hcd_gse242187.note: GSE242187 is the RNA-seq SubSeries; GSE242189 is its SuperSeries and the survey carries BOTH as separate candidates. They are the SAME six libraries — the SuperSeries ships no data of its own and GEO serves the identical GSE242187_5A_vs_3A_control_vs_comparison.deseq.counts.csv.gz for both. Listed here so the SuperSeries candidate is marked integrated rather than left open as a duplicate of work already done. PRJNA1011935 is the SubSeries BioProject, PRJNA1011920 the SuperSeries one.

mouse_hypo_glp1_gse245727.note: GSE245727 is SubSeries [II] (hypothalamus) of SuperSeries GSE245728. SubSeries [I] = GSE244607 is brainstem + nucleus accumbens with a different arm set and is deliberately NOT listed: it is other tissue, not the same data under another accession.

mouse_vlpo_galanin_sleep_gse132308.note: PRJNA547578 is the BioProject/SRA parent of GEO GSE132308. The explorer uses the official GSE132308 unnormalized gene-count matrix and the matched-ZT6 sleep-deprivation contrast.

rat_pvn_stress_gse261833.note: PRJNA1089181 is the BioProject/SRA parent of GEO GSE261833. Both accessions describe the same 15 rat-PVN control, stress-model, and minocycline libraries; the explorer integrates the focused control-versus-model contrast once.

cattle_hypo_nutrition_gse153495.note: PRJNA642849/SRP269219 are the BioProject/SRA parent identifiers for the same 29 GSE153495 remaining-hypothalamus libraries; integrated once under GSE153495.

cattle_arc_nutrition_gse153498.note: PRJNA642856/SRP269224 are the BioProject/SRA parent identifiers for the same 29 GSE153498 arcuate-region libraries; integrated once under GSE153498.

human_hypo_pituitary_organoid_gse301692.note: PRJNA1285990 is the BioProject/SRA parent of GSE301692; the explorer integrates the focused day-15 success-versus-failure organoid contrast once.

pig_hypo_low_growth_gse324226.note: PRJNA1429082/SRP681584 are the BioProject/SRA parent identifiers for the 48 GSE324226 pig libraries; the explorer integrates the day-39 hypothalamus contrast once.

cattle_hypo_diet_restriction_gse49540.note: PRJNA214208/SRP028518 are the BioProject/SRA parent identifiers for the same 21 GSE49540 cattle hypothalamus libraries; the explorer integrates the focused control-versus-restricted-anovulatory contrast once.
